ranges.description: Hyuk Mujin is a young man, 180 cm tall, with a lean, agile musculature. He has an ugly face with distinctive thick, caterpillar-like eyebrows, and very pale skin, as white as a Caucasian's. He wears the navy-blue martial robe of the Taewon Jin family.
